title.zh: Polymarket因虚假获利宣传内容解雇首席营销官，CFTC展开调查
title.en: Polymarket Fires CMO Matthew Modabber Amid Fake Promotion Claims and CFTC Probe

current_state.zh: Polymarket dismissed its chief marketing officer Matthew Modabber after an internal investigation into his team's creation of fake webpages and staged videos showing users earning illusory trading profits, conduct already reported by the WSJ and under CFTC investigation.
